Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) system with an anoxic tank, swing air tank, aerobic tank, post-anoxic tank, and a 0.4 million gallon flow equalization tank.

For the first two phases, Phase A and Phase B, the WWTF will consist of membrane bioreactor (MBR) package plants with average maximum dry weather design flows of 0.25 million gallons per day (mgd) and 0.5 mgd, respectively.

When flows approach the capacity for Phase B, construction will begin on Phase I, which will consist of a permanent Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) system with an anoxic tank, swing air tank, aerobic tank, post-anoxic tank, and a 0.4 million gallon flow equalization tank.
